blockers.reason: Run with -SkipModelessCloseAttempt. PostMessage(WM_CLOSE) does close the modeless UserForm (wm_close_status=completed) but then leaves Excel COM unavailable (RPC 0x800706BA / DISP_E_EXCEPTION on the next excel.Run), so the held-reference release/export step cannot complete. Reconfirmed on a 2026-06-27 live attempt.
blockers.detail: The modeless system-close -> QueryClose(CloseMode=0) -> Terminate ORDERING is already captured live in W005 (the modeless interaction capture observed a final Terminate after a CloseMode=0 QueryClose). The residual not captured here is specifically the held-reference state during a modeless system close. A future capture should drive the close with SendKeys Alt+F4 -- which closed a UserForm cleanly without destabilizing COM in oxforms-0a0.24 -- rather than PostMessage(WM_CLOSE), then export after releasing the held reference.
blockers.non_claim: No modeless system-close Terminate timing is claimed from this capture; see W005 for the CloseMode=0 -> Terminate ordering.

blockers.reason: Run with -SkipModalReturnAttempt: a macro-driven Show vbModal blocks the COM thread (excel.Run does not return until the modal closes), so the capture cannot hold the modal open and drive/export it from the same thread. This is a structural limit of the macro-driven path, not an Excel availability flake.
blockers.detail: The modal Terminate ORDERING is already captured live by oxforms-0a0.24 in captures/nested-modal-lifecycle-20260627T141239Z: inner Unload -> QueryClose(CloseMode=1) -> Terminate -> AfterUnload; inner Alt+F4 system close -> QueryClose(CloseMode=0) -> Terminate; inner Hide fires no Terminate (the instance stays alive). The residual not captured here is specifically the held-reference state observed during a modal Hide/Unload return. Capturing that would require the SendInput-driven modal pattern (trigger Show vbModal from a launcher-form button via injected input, then drive the modal with injected input) rather than excel.Run; it is not attempted by this macro-driven fixture.
